description: The Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI) on Sentinel-3A, a 21-band (Oa01-Oa21, 0.4-1.02 um) pushbroom imaging spectrometer. The curves are ESA's mean relative spectral response function per band.
short_description: Sentinel-3A Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI), 21 bands
facility_description: Sentinel-3 is the Copernicus ocean and land monitoring mission (ESA/EUMETSAT), with satellites Sentinel-3A (2016) and Sentinel-3B (2018).
